en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist, elongated hotel or resort building on a wooded hillside. In the foreground there is a bench and a rocky wall, while the background reveals a sloping, tree‑covered landscape. The printed captions on the image side read "Pécs" at the lower left and "Üdülőszálló a Mecseken" at the lower right. The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, a Hungarian postage stamp with the Holy Crown, a circular postmark from Pécs dated 1941, and a publisher mark "FOTÓ WEINSTOCK".
